profile.headline: Software Engineering Asc Manager at Lockheed Martin
profile.summary: I easily interact with multiple types of customers, illustrating hard work and technical competency. My outgoing personality makes me a key asset to any team, assisted by a good attitude and humor, in order to complete the task in high visibility situations. I excel at customer relations and combining big picture concepts with experience and dedication to deliver expected results.

positions.title: Ground Systems Engineer Sr
positions.description:
• Advanced Technical Leadership Program (ATLP) Class of 2018
• Ground Systems Engineer Technical Lead which includes supervision for training of 12 Ground Systems Engineers (GSEs), mentor of junior team members, and maintain constant communication between the GSE team and management.
• Conduct daily briefs for military and civilian crews entailing shift activity and issues and perform basic Systems Administration duties, including User Account management.
• Developed and implemented a training program for Remedy Problem Reports at multiple sites
(MCS/MCSB/ITC), co-developed the GSE Training Suite for GEO, and helped maintain the GSE SharePoint Resource suite.
• Provide 24/7 scheduled on-call support for shift GSEs and provide over-the-phone technical support.
• Directly supports the Air Force Missile Warning mission; provide software, network, and technical operations support for the Space Based Infra-Red System (SBIRS) ground station (GEO & HEO) that includes system integration and installation and telemetry tracking command and control (TT&C) as well as Block 10 support for various activities and system training.
• Troubleshoot software outages and system downtime utilizing UNIX (SunOS/IRIX64/Linux) and SQL knowledge in a SYBASE environment.
• Identify and document causes of operating software problems and determine appropriate solutions and gather logs and specific files for network transfer as requested by the customer and software development teams; gather data for analysis and tracking of problems in the network or software.
• Added functionality to existing applications and scripts using Perl and Perl TK to aid in troubleshooting and daily operations.
• Create GSE Read Files and procedures to be used as how-to guides for troubleshooting procedures of known problems and important information advisories.
• Maintain the Shift Schedule for 16 GSEs that include tracking of vacations, training and reserve hours.

positions.title: Ground Systems Engineer
positions.description:
- Directly supports the Air Force Missile Warning mission; provide software, network, and technical operations support for the Space Based Infra-Red System (SBIRS) HEO ground station that includes system integration and installation and telemetry tracking command and control (TT&C).  
- Troubleshoot software outages and system downtime.
- Identify and document causes of operating software problems and determine appropriate solutions.  
- Conduct daily briefs for military and civilian crews entailing shift activity and issues and perform basic Systems Administration duties, including User Account management.
- Create scripts/programs utilizing C-Shell, K-Shell, Perl and Perl/Tk to be used for monitoring the network and overall system health of the system and created an improved interactive program in Excel with Visual Basic for Applications that displays the orbit data from HEO satellite flight schedules.
- Gather logs and specific files for network transfer as requested by the customer; gather data for analysis and tracking of problems in the network or software.

positions.title: SATCOM
positions.description:
•	Troubleshot 20 launch facility sites daily on satellite communication systems; collaborated with co-workers to find appropriate solution in a timely fashion & served as shop supervisor of 4 member team.  
•	Developed and implemented a database program utilizing Visual Basic for Applications (VBA) & SQL coding to track the troubleshooting procedures conducted on 20 different nuclear launch facilities in Montana; created daily, monthly, yearly and site specific reports to determine if a more serious problem exist.  
•	Created a training database to track and schedule training for 9 employees and maintain the training progress in the employee’s training records.  
•	Team lead for 50+ dispatches to the launch facilities and was responsible for all actions of the team and vouch for all equipment and vehicles entering and leaving the missile facility.  
•	Troubleshooting and maintenance included SHF/UHF/EHF Satellite systems involving DSCS III, FLEETSAT and MILSTAR satellites.
•	Awarded the Air Force Achievement Medal for work on the Intercontinental Ballistic Missile (ICBM) Super-High Frequency Satellite Terminal.
•	Awarded Airman “Below the Zone” resulting in an early promotion to Senior Airman.
•	Completed Airman Leadership School with honors; received Academic Achievement Award
